I've honestly had more issues with the crapola that is sometimes the audio connectors on audio cards, with those ridiculous orange/teal/light-brown/greenish/kaki coloring which I suspect is hard to tell apart in imperfect lighting conditions even to the rare tetrachromats.

In terms of wronging others, the only meaningful thing I can think of is choosing horrible color combinations by not being able to tell, say, blue from violet or pink from azure from gray or green from yellow (depends a lot on hue, BTW).
